businesses.business: industrial hardware and security products manufacturer

offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures engineered industrial hardware, security products and metal castings. Sells to OEMs in transportation, utility, marine and industrial markets, and to security and lock customers. Products are made in North American and Asian plants.

primary_products.value: industrial hardware (latches, hinges, handles); security products (locks, keys, access control); metal castings; custom engineered components; marine hardware

customer_segment.value: B2B: OEMs in truck, trailer, bus, utility, marine and industrial equipment, security product distributors; B2G: government and institutional users of security locks, such as postal and correctional

end_markets.value: transportation and heavy trucks; utilities; marine; security and government; industrial equipment

revenue_model.value: product sales: hardware, locks and castings sold to OEMs and distributors

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures hardware and security products from purchased metals and components, sold to OEMs and distributors; component supplier: supplies engineered latches, hinges and castings into customer equipment

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Mexico, Taiwan, China and other export markets

specialization.value: related lines: industrial hardware, security products and metal castings

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to OEM manufacturers and large accounts; distributors / dealers: locksmith and security product distributors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: manufacturing environmental and safety rules, trade tariffs, and product standards for security and marine hardware

notes: Recent portfolio changes (divestitures or acquisitions) may not be reflected.
